summary: Compresses the lodging search and Nantucket history while retaining the church encounter, ominous inn sign, and extended cold-and-poverty meditation.
acceptable_changes: Omits the cobblestone whaling anecdote and reduces repeated descriptions of costly inns.
Condenses the Lazarus and Dives passage while locally distinguishing its poor and rich figures.
risks: Compression reduces the biblical and geographical elaboration of the poverty meditation.
review_focus: Check the retained racialized church description and the shift from physical cold to social satire for voice and tonal continuity.
